properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 26 at 6:54AM CDT until October 26 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Southeastern Dallam County in the panhandle of Texas...
Northeastern Hartley County in the panhandle of Texas...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding. Low-water crossings are inundated
with water and may not be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 654 AM CDT, local law enforcement reported flooding in the
warned area. Flooding is already occurring. Between 3 and 4
inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Dalhart and Hartley.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM CDT THIS MORNING
